headline: topk_engine (K=64, N=256) — PASS @ Fmax 384 MHz, LUT 7418, DSP 0, II=1, Latency 327 cycles.
notes_for_orch:
Three iterations to land — v1 (argmin-replace) collapsed timing, v2 (systolic but with m_axi) blew the LUT cap on burst engines, v3 (systolic + ap_memory only) is the keeper. Algorithm = each of K=64 cells does a local compare with the streaming input + a 3-way mux selecting (own / right-neighbor / new input). No DSP — pure compare/mux logic. Fmax 384 MHz with comfortable margin.

KEY DESIGN DECISION FOR ORCH: I removed the m_axi pragmas (used ap_memory only) because this IP is intended to be CALLED FROM T0022 as a submodule, not directly from the PS. T0022's top function will carry the m_axi for the whole pipeline. If you ever want a standalone register-mapped IP version of topk, the algorithm itself is unchanged — just re-add the m_axi pragmas, expect ~+4500 LUT for the burst engines (total ~12k LUT, still well under VCK190 capacity).

Forensics for the v1/v2 logs preserved in coord/reports/T0020/ for future similar problems.
